system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"I have been experiencing a lot of connectivity issues with Chromecast lately. Did a recent update botch something?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! It sounds frustrating! Can you try testing your connection with another device or app? Let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks empathy and troubleshooting steps; remove '/AI' and add more helpful guidance."}
